Fires on highly predictable, high-frequency function-word slots — chiefly the preposition "of" (also "in", "to", or an opening quote) immediately following a noun that strongly selects it (e.g. "the power **of**", "Executors **of**", "refers **to**", "dips **in** the hot pot"); it is suppressed by unexpected/lower-frequency words in the same connective slot (e.g. "amidst", "why", "summit", "claimed").
